verdict.rationale: The docs show first-party client code for building against the cloud API, including `client.runs.create(...)` and polling `runs.events()` with a cursor. They also point to an official open-source Python library for automating the web from your own code with any LLM. Missing for 10: explicit SDK naming with package/install docs, evidence of language coverage beyond Python (e.g. a TypeScript SDK), a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.
